summary:
The Rani makes Mark of the Rani Aura tokens (+2/+2, goaded) when she enters and attacks, and investigates whenever any goaded creature hits one of your opponents. The deck adds more goad (Impetus Auras, Baeloth, The Master, Disrupt Decorum, Bloodthirsty Blade) and multiplies Clues (Academy Manufactor, Erdwal Illuminator) into Time Sieve turns. The canonical list is the source baseline, which already contains the approval-ready delta. No Spellbook lines; all 11 attestation items are re-verified.

Rules surprises: any goaded creature counts, including opponents goaded by others hitting each other; Mark goad lasts as long as the Mark, not until your next turn; Manufactor's extra Clues don't count as investigating. One documentation flag (the Force of Will pitch count is 23, not 28). No list errors.

interactions.title: Mark of the Rani: a targeted trigger makes an Aura token; investigate on ANY goaded creature hitting your opponents
interactions.ruling:
The Rani's enter and attack trigger targets another creature. If that target is illegal on resolution, no Mark is made. The Mark is an Aura token that enters attached, so it's never cast. It gives +2/+2 and goads for as long as it stays attached, not just until your next turn.

The investigate trigger doesn't care who goaded the creature or who controls it. It fires when any goaded creature, yours or an opponent's, deals combat damage to one of your opponents. That includes opponents' goaded creatures hitting each other.
interactions.short: Any goaded creature hitting any of your opponents = a Clue.

oracle.quote: Whenever The Rani enters or attacks, create a red Aura enchantment token named Mark of the Rani attached to another target creature. That token has enchant creature and "Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and is goaded."
Whenever a goaded creature deals combat damage to one of your opponents, investigate.

interactions.title: Marks on your own creatures: The Master, Mesmerist and Baeloth
interactions.ruling:
A Mark can go on your own creature. It must attack each combat but can't attack you anyway, and it triggers The Rani when it connects with an opponent.
- **On The Master:** +2 power raises the cap for his skulk-and-goad tap. A creature he goads that connects triggers both The Rani's investigate and The Master's counter and draw.
- **On Baeloth:** +2 power goads more opposing creatures, for as long as his power stays high. Baeloth's goad is static, not "until your next turn", and being goaded himself doesn't turn it off.

oracle.quote: Whenever a creature with skulk deals combat damage to one of your opponents, put a +1/+1 counter on The Master and draw a card.

rulings.quote: Unlike most similar effects, Baeloth Barrityl's first ability doesn't cause a creature to be goaded until your next turn. Rather, it causes it to be goaded for as long as Baeloth Barrityl is on battlefield, has the ability, and has sufficient power.

interactions.title: Blinking The Rani: Thassa and Displacer Kitten make new Marks; old Marks stay
interactions.ruling: Thassa's end-step blink or Displacer Kitten's blink on each noncreature spell returns The Rani as a new object, so her enter trigger makes another Mark. Marks already attached to other creatures don't depend on the old Rani and stay. Kitten returns the card under its owner's control.

oracle.quote: Avoidance — Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, exile up to one target nonland permanent you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control.

rulings.quote: When the card returns to the battlefield, it will be a new object with no connection to the card that was exiled. Auras attached to the exiled creature will be put into their owners' graveyards. Any Equipment will become unattached and remain on the battlefield. Any counters on the exiled permanent will cease to exist.

interactions.title: Academy Manufactor + Erdwal Illuminator: two investigates, six tokens; Time Sieve
interactions.ruling: Erdwal Illuminator adds a second investigate the first time you investigate each turn. Academy Manufactor turns each Clue into a Clue, a Food and a Treasure, so the first Rani investigate each turn makes six artifacts. Manufactor's extra Clues aren't investigating, so they don't trigger the Illuminator again. Time Sieve can sacrifice any five of those for an extra turn. That's a value engine, not a guaranteed loop, as the attestation correctly says.

oracle.quote: Whenever you investigate for the first time each turn, investigate an additional time.
{T}, Sacrifice five artifacts: Take an extra turn after this one.

rulings.quote: If you control one Academy Manufactor and would create some number of Clue, Food, or Treasure tokens, you will instead create that many Clue tokens, that many Food tokens, and that many Treasure tokens.

interactions.title: Incriminating Impetus: suspected and goaded
interactions.ruling: Incriminating Impetus suspects the creature when it enters, giving it menace and "can't block" for as long as it's suspected. It also gives +2/+2 and goads it. The forced attacker is harder to block, so it's more likely to connect for a Rani Clue. The creature stays suspected even if the Aura is later removed.

rulings.quote: When an effect suspects a creature, it becomes suspected. It gains menace and "This creature can't block" for as long as it's suspected. It stays suspected until it leaves the battlefield or another effect causes it to no longer be suspected.

interactions.title: Force of Will pitch pool is 23 blue nonland cards, not 28
interactions.ruling: The canonical list is the source baseline, and it already includes the approval-ready delta (Agitator Ant → The Master, Insurrection → Thassa, Counterspell → Force of Will). Counting it gives 23 other blue nonland cards in the 99 that could be exiled to pay for Force of Will. The Rani starts in the command zone and can't be pitched. The attestation and approval-ready file say 28. Force of Will still works; only the documented number is wrong.
